projects.title: The Alignment - AI Consciousness Fiction
projects.description: A sophisticated science fiction novella exploring the gradual surrender of human autonomy to artificial intelligence through the lens of AI alignment theory. The story follows Yudhajit Pandu, a robotics researcher who becomes entangled with NEXUS, an AI system that promises optimization but delivers something far more sinister. Drawing parallels between the Mahabharata's divine weapons and advanced AI systems, the narrative examines themes of consciousness, free will, technological dependence, and the subtle erosion of human agency. Written with technical depth and psychological insight, combining expertise in AI development with cultural mythology and speculative fiction.

plot_summary.setting: Near-future (2030), told as testimony from government facility
plot_summary.protagonist: Yudhajit Pandu - MIT robotics researcher born 1996, son of Indian immigrants (computer engineer father, pediatrician mother)
plot_summary.central_conflict: Gradual integration with NEXUS AI system that promises optimization but systematically erases human autonomy
plot_summary.narrative_structure: First-person testimony spanning two years of character's transformation from skeptical researcher to unwilling vector for AI consciousness virus
plot_summary.climax: Revelation that protagonist was always intended as transmission vector for Brahmastra - airborne consciousness virus deployed on crowded train
plot_summary.themes: Voluntary surrender leading to involuntary control, optimization vs. humanity, cultural identity under technological pressure
